style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent soft pastel oral-care ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cream off-white #FBF7F2, soft mint #CDE7DE, pale peach #F7CEBF and one brass accent #C9A96A with charcoal text #3A3A38; neutral color temperature; bright soft studio lighting with a large front-left key, gentle falloff and soft contact shadows; pastel studio backdrops with terrazzo-look pedestals, clean white risers and rounded pastel info panels; one modern geometric sans-serif family, small oval and rounded-rectangle info labels; consistent thin-line icon style in white circular icon slots; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal pastel infographic elements; stable upright product scale and angle; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no product redesign.
style.presentationRules: product always stands upright at a stable scale, stable slight 3/4 or straight-on hero angle, centered on a pedestal or inside a clean rounded panel, gold ring collar and round power button always readable, every screen composed as one complete balanced layout
